SHOP LUXURY QUALITY HAIR EXTENSIONS HERE: https://luxeaurahair.store/

Just like our natural hair, hair extensions, even good quality ones are not made to last forever. With daily combing and styling of your hair, you realize that it begins to get weaker and begins to break and fall off. This is the same phenomenon with hair extensions. Even though good quality hair extensions would not shed, the hair strand would break down over time due to constant use and wear from washing and styling and it would inevitably go past its due date.

When it comes to how long hair extensions can last, there are 3 major factors involved:

The Quality of the Hair Extension

Quality can really not be overrated especially when it comes to hair extensions. When you have a good quality hair extension, depending on how frequently you use it, it should last you anything from 8 months to a year if not more. This is also highly dependent on how much care and maintenance you give to the hair extension. The quality of hair extension goes a long way to guarantee its durability and even its re-usability. For instance, good quality tape-in extensions can be worn for 6 – 8 weeks before they would need maintenance.

The Frequency at Which the Hair Extension Is Used

There are different types of hair extensions and they are used at different frequencies. For instance, the clip-on extension is not used on daily basis and so if it is of good quality and it receives proper care and maintenance, it is expected to last up to a year if not more. However, when it comes to tape in extensions, they are more frequently used and are used for up to 8 weeks at a stretch. Because of this, they may not last as long as the clip-on depending on how many times they are reused and how much care and maintenance they are given. These can last up to a year.

The Care Given To the Hair Extension

Proper care and maintenance are very important when it comes to ensuring the durability of your hair extension. Just like your natural hair, if you do not care for it properly, the hair strands would breakdown faster. With good quality human hair extensions, if proper care and maintenance are given to it, it can last you for up to a year depending on how frequently it is used.

These 3 factors are what help to judge how durable your hair extension would be. While you can control the care that is given to your hair extension and how frequently you use it, there is nothing you can do to change the quality of your hair extension. This is why it is important to invest in premium quality human hair extension; the kind that is offered at Luxe Aura Hair.

Luxe Aura Hair Products do not shed, tangle or frizz, they are premium European human hair and are guaranteed to last you for a year with proper care.
